scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the live remote shoulder-conditioning check-in before leaving for the evening wheel class.
Emerging Need: The session is underway after check-in, then the portal connection fails and the trainer slot can continue only through backup access saved elsewhere.
Decision Context: Current notices establish the short rejoin window, while saved conditioning guidance and the stored access note distinguish supervised continuation from improvised band work.
Consequence: Once the release notice arrives, the started session remains blocked and the planned pre-class conditioning benefit cannot be recovered that day.

parameter.title: MoveWell shoulder-conditioning check-in
parameter.description: Live remote trainer check-in before the evening wheel class; camera and mat setup at 16:10.

parameter.subject: Today’s 4:15 shoulder check-in: portal queue opens at 4:10
parameter.body: The live portal queue opens at 4:10 p.m. If you are disconnected after check-in, the trainer can hold your slot for 12 minutes. Use the backup audio access listed in your client note if the video token fails; the front desk cannot text access codes after 4:30.

parameter.content: I’m checked into the MoveWell portal and have the mat and green strap out. Starting the warm-up now before I head to wheel class later.

parameter.subject: Connection dropped during your 4:15 shoulder check-in
parameter.body: Your video connection dropped after trainer check-in. The session is still being held until 4:32 p.m. The browser token cannot be refreshed from this error screen; continuing requires the backup audio access from your client note.

parameter.subject: Trainer slot released for today’s 4:15 check-in
parameter.body: The rejoin window for the 4:15 p.m. shoulder-conditioning check-in has closed, and the trainer slot has been released. No same-day makeup slots remain for this supervised session.
